evidence: Normative quota capability inventory collected in Phase 0 from TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.md section 5 and section 6.6, ADR-0001, ADR-0002, ADR-0003 and the sanitized environment probe: OpenCode serve exposes no quota endpoint, Cursor ACP and AGY CLI expose no quota API, Codex quota was not confirmed. No credentials, tokens or private user paths are included.

sanitization.note: Probe-local identifiers were replaced with fixed placeholders; secret values are never recorded.

normativeRules.localOrEstimatedParticipation: LocallyCalculated and Estimated participate only after explicit user opt-in and never rank above a fresh trusted snapshot.
normativeRules.dashboardRowRequired: Every connected account/model family has a dashboard row even when the provider exposes no quota API.
forbiddenRepresentations: numeric default when valueState is not numeric
full or empty gauge rendering for Unsupported, Unknown, Stale or Error
silent inference of numeric quota values from indirect signals
hard reserve comparison in a bucket that was never reported
normativeRules.ttlConfiguration: Per source; the provider-reported freshness wins over the default.
normativeRules.sharedSnapshotReference: Dashboard and Routing Engine must reference the same quotaSnapshotId.

quotaApi.evidence: The discovered `opencode serve` 1.18.31 inventory contains no `/quota` endpoint; only `/stats` for local token spend of the current session is confirmed.

quotaFields.notes: Local token spend of the current session. It is not a provider quota and does not participate in automatic quota scoring without explicit user opt-in.

quotaApi.evidence: Custom OpenCode-compatible provider configured with a baseUrl override; no quota API and no plugin bridge were confirmed in Phase 0.

quotaFields.notes: Dashboard must still render the account/model family row with an honest Unknown state and no numeric value.

quotaApi.evidence: ADR-0003 section 8: Cursor Agent/ACP exposes no quota API; acp-capabilities.json reports quota.api=Unsupported.

quotaFields.notes: Quota is never derived from indirect signals; the dashboard row stays Unsupported.

quotaApi.evidence: Phase 0 did not confirm a Codex quota API. Accepted topology uses StarCliProxy with isolated CODEX_HOME profiles; direct Codex and Codex-via-OpenCode are not productive routes. The codex-cli providerId is retained as an inventory identifier.

quotaFields.notes: Unknown stays Unknown until verified evidence exists; fabricated values are forbidden.

quotaApi.evidence: AGY CLI 1.1.23 provides no account quota query command.

quotaFields.notes: The product integrates AGY through star-cliproxy after selecting an agy-profile context; the CLI itself exposes no confirmed quota API.
